title: Policy Resolution Trace
description: Append-only replay/audit trace for selector matching, inheritance expansion, policy operations, grants, denies, locks and final seven-gate decisions. Raw event payload is not required and should normally be absent.
x-trace-invariants: seq values are contiguous, unique, and ascending from 0
every cause_event_id references an earlier event
every matched policy has at least one matched selector event
every inheritance edge is emitted before operations inherited through that edge
every policy operation has exactly one operation_evaluated event
every grant_decision operation has exactly one grant_evaluated event
every explicit/default/reapplied deny has a deny_applied event
every acquired/inherited/reapplied lock has a lock_applied event
every one of the seven gates has exactly one gate_final event
result.final_event_id references exactly one resolution_final event
declaration order is never used as an authority signal
raw event payload and secrets are not embedded
matched tag clauses in replayable traces carry fact_provenance with source_kind=tag_projection or are fully covered by selector_facts_digest and referenced private replay material
tag provenance may explain selector applicability but never supplies authority_source, authorization_ref, grant_ref, deny authority or lock authority
